title: pityrogramma fauriei
intro: Pityrogramma fauriei, commonly known as the Faurie's fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine in East Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pityrogramma fauriei include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of health benefits and therapeutic actions.
